name: melonDS DS (RetroArch)
location: RetroArch savefile_directory (or next to the ROM), plus the ROM folder name and/or "melonDS DS" depending on sort_savefiles_by_content_enable and sort_savefiles_enable
notes: Raw SRAM buffer exposed by the core through retro_get_memory_data(RETRO_MEMORY_SAVE_RAM) (melonds-ds src/libretro/sram.cpp), written as is by RetroArch. Its size comes from melonDS's ROM list, which has no 32 KiB entry: 32 KiB FRAM games get 64 KiB files, absorbed by the server's size rules. Stays to_verify until a real round trip with RetroArch.
